integrity: The infinite claim is supported by a complete determinant case split; exact finite computation independently checks the algebraic criterion on all normalized triples through \(N=120\). Literature comparisons distinguish the local iff classification from previously published global square-free/non-square-free statements.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies principal 3-by-3 Fourier submatrices only; it does not classify nonprincipal 3-by-3 minors or larger principal minors.
Finite exact computation through \(N=120\) is corroborative rather than a proof of the infinite statement.
A differently phrased or poorly indexed prior local classification remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact singularity criterion for three-point principal Fourier minors
